text:
Type: white wood slat plant pot
Use: covering a nursery pot for a floor or table plant; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, coastal
Materials: thin wood strips with a white painted finish, wooden bands, small nails, plastic inner liner
Colors: white, pale natural wood showing through
Shape: round tapered bucket of vertical slats held by two horizontal bands, open gaps between strips, light and rustic
Feel: fresh, relaxed, natural, homey
Goes with: leafy green plants, linen, light wood, pastel tones; farmhouse, coastal or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: KALASA
product.description: A plastic inner pot makes the plant pot waterproof.
